summary: ChronoScale Holdings filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary ChronoScale Intermediate, LLC amended a secured promissory note with B. Riley Commercial Capital. The first amendment extends the maturity of the $2.0 million term loan to November 12, 2026, and designates the sale of guarantor Ekso Bionics, Inc. as a permitted disposition. The original loan required repayment upon receipt of $2.4 million in new equity proceeds. No board recommendation or advisors were disclosed. The filing is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation, though the permitted sale signals possible future divestiture activity.
